scientific_integrity: The Parikh semilinearity theorem and classical LoopPDL semantics are prior work. Reproducible finite checks support, but do not replace, the full proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unlabelled finite directed cycles, one total successor and its inverse, no propositional letters and no program intersection; novelty is qualified by historical-priority uncertainty. The arithmetic characterization is proved, but computational complexity of the translation is not optimized.
title: Exact arithmetic spectra of variable-free loop dynamic logic on directed cycles
